mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_usage_log (user_id, username, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{cost})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS todayTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS todayCost, COUNT(*) AS todayCalls FROM ai_usage_log WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
